product.name: Natoora Italian Vanilla Persimmons
product.detailed_description: FLAVOUR IS A FRONTIER Natoora Italian Vanilla Persimmon - We source Vanilla Persimmons from Campania, where they grow without the use of chemical sprays or fertilisers. - Picked ripe, they will mature further off the tree but remain firm-fleshed and retain a mild astringency. - Persimmons require a drop in temperature to undergo a process similar to bletting, converting their bitter tannins to sugars to reach full maturity. - This natural bletting process can result in dark markings on the skin and in the flesh – far from signs of spoilage, these signal perfect ripeness and are intrinsic to the vanilla variety. Take it further - Slice thinly, toss with bitter leaves and ricotta. - Cut into wedges, roast with honey. Our packaging is plastic-free - We have developed our own revolutionary packaging which is entirely plastic-free and home disposable. Each of our recyclable cardboard punnets is flow-wrapped with home-compostable film which, unlike traditional plastic flow-wrap, disintegrates within 180 days. Dispose of the black punnet in your normal recycling and the clear film in your food waste bin. - Each punnet bears the ‘Plastic Free’ mark of A Plastic Planet, a grassroots movement which aims to turn off the plastic tap. Natoora's radical approach to seasonal sourcing is shaping the future of food - We are revolutionising the food system. - We work direct with growers who value flavour, biodiversity and heritage over yield. - We give them the support they need to build a better future for food, rooted in small scale, sustainable agriculture that gives back to our planet.

product.name: Natoora Sicilian Pomegranate
product.detailed_description: FLAVOUR IS A FRONTIER Natoora Sicilian Pomegranate - We source our exceptionally heavy, syrup-rich Pomegranates direct from Marco, our grower in Sicily. - Pomegranates don't ripen after being picked, so they must be harvested at full maturity. - Marco and his team use a refractometer to check sucrose levels, ensuring the perfect balance of acidity, sweetness, and shape before harvesting. - His ripe, dark seeded pomegranates are a world apart from the bland, long-travelled fruit we see on the market. Slice into quarters horizontally, whack the outer skin with a wooden spoon to remove seeds. Take it further - Toss with shaved fennel, blood orange, and olive oil. - Pair with slow-roasted duck and a pomegranate glaze for a rich, sweet-acidic finish. Natoora's radical approach to seasonal sourcing is shaping the future of food - We are revolutionising the food system. - We work direct with growers who value flavour, biodiversity and heritage over yield. - We give them the support they need to build a better future for food, rooted in small scale, sustainable agriculture that gives back to our planet.
product.dietary_information: Suitable for Vegans; Suitable for Vegetarians
product.brand_marketing: What is Natoora? Natoora was founded in 2004 in a bid to bring flavour, seasonality and transparency back to the way we source and eat food. Today, we work closely with responsible growers to find fruit and veg varieties chosen for flavour, many of which never make it into the mainstream food system. From seed selection to traditional growing methods, we champion the people and practices behind good produce, connecting growers with chefs and home cooks all around the world.
